echoParts: In all your ways acknowledge him
and he will make straight your paths.
verseText: Trust in the Lord with all your heart, and do not lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make straight your paths.
meaning: God wants us to trust him instead of depending only on what we think we understand. When we look to him in every part of life, he guides us in the right way.
